objective: Analyze preserved Phase 07 schedules without altering source evidence, freezing parameters, or converting descriptive results into security claims.
source_requirements: verify the relative-path SHA-256 bundle manifest before analysis when a bundle directory is provided
cross-check the Phase 07 metrics CSV against the JSON result records
retain the source JSON SHA-256 in every Phase 08 analysis bundle
treat the preserved Phase 07 directory as read-only evidence
denominator_controls: low-n groups remain visible and are flagged
fault-kind and fault-phase groups declare overlapping membership
outcome and fault-count groups declare mutually exclusive membership
success fractions are descriptive proportions only
trace_controls: verify per-fault metric counts against the schedule
verify contiguous append-only event sequence numbers
verify outcome-specific consistency across alignment, verification, security, and availability fields
diagnostic_controls: diagnostic labels are derived from recorded events
diagnostic labels are explicitly descriptive and not causal
all non-success cases are exported for adversarial review

requirements: the same serialized schedule is reused for every grid point
fault actions beyond a reduced transmission budget are counted as unreachable
every grid output remains descriptive and unfrozen

mandatory_external_review_stop_points: before freezing the experiment population or seed set
before freezing retry budgets or candidate lifetimes
before adopting denominator exclusions or success thresholds
before defining or freezing the statistical analysis plan
before selecting T1 as the final treatment
before interpreting results as evidence of post-compromise security
before using derived results as publication evidence or external claims
